newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Bangladesh taka ends firmer, retains early gains.
newsitem.headline: Bangladesh taka ends firmer, retains early gains.

text.p: Bangladesh taka retained early gains and ended firmer at 42.5460/5490 to the dollar in interbank trading on Tuesday against Monday's closing at 42.5490/5500.
The local unit opened stronger at 42.5480/5500 against the dollar and edged up further as demand for greenback rose, dealers said.
"Banks shrugged off fear and reluctance to sell the U.S. currency after the central bank made no downward adjustment of the local unit," one dealer said.
